test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.**

Surrender
solution: The correct answer is: **Withstand**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Surrender **means to give up or yield to someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को त्यागना या समर्पण करना) • **For example- ***They agreed to surrender the town to the rebels.* • Marked option **Withstand **means to resist or endure something. (किसी चीज़ का विरोध करना या सहना) • **For example- ***Our army tried to withstand the enemy onslaught.* • So, it is clear that the two words are **opposite** in meaning as surrender involves giving up, while withstand involves resisting. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Option 1 - **Waive **means to give up or relinquish a claim or right. (किसी दावे या अधिकार को त्यागना या छोड़ देना) • Option 2 - **Stay **means to remain in a particular place or state. (किसी विशेष स्थान या राज्य में रहना) • Option 3 - **Calm **means to be peaceful or quiet. (शांतिपूर्ण या शांत रहना) 1f2:T866, The correct answer is Option 1: "**You are going to figure out everything.**"
